rules.useOnlyPublicClasses: Use only pl-l-*, pl-c-*, pl-u-* classes documented in the component contract. Never invent utility or component classes.
rules.semanticHtml: Use real HTML elements: table, form, fieldset, label, input, button, nav, main, section, dialog, details. Do not replace them with divs.
rules.applicationOwns: The application owns data, state, focus management, keyboard controllers, persistence, and timers. Porchlight owns CSS contracts and static semantics.
rules.tokens: Prefer --pl-* tokens for spacing, color, radius, motion, and control sizing. Do not introduce parallel scales.
rules.behavior: Do not claim a behavior is built in unless the component contract says so. The docs list the responsibilities the application keeps.
